purpose: Official planning-policy, conservation, building-control and property-search routes for batch 13 candidates. No candidate-specific legal or planning conclusion is published until exact address, title or red-line geometry is queried.

sources.coverage: the borough's 19 conservation areas and published character appraisals, including Rugby Town Centre
sources.binding_limit: The council confirms the conservation-area framework, but exact inclusion of 19 Warwick Street requires a current boundary and property-address join. The source does not establish ownership, sale authority, EPC, rates or planning permission.

sources.coverage: adopted 18 March 2026 development brief for the principal Rugby Central redevelopment area
sources.binding_limit: The SPD guides redevelopment within its mapped area but is not itself planning permission. No Warwick Street or Castle Mound Way conclusion is made until the property is checked against the adopted boundary and relevant policies.

sources.coverage: property and site-specific pre-application advice route for proposed development or change of use
sources.binding_limit: Pre-application advice is non-binding and does not prejudice a later planning decision. It cannot support residential-conversion or alternative-use claims for 19 Warwick Street or Mitchell Court unless the actual response and submitted plan are read.

sources.coverage: Warwick District Local Plan 2011-2029, policy maps and address-linked interactive mapping
sources.binding_limit: The interactive GIS is illustrative and not a legal record. Beaurevoir Way portfolio plots require exact title and geometry joins before amenity-land, allocation, conservation, highway or other policy conclusions are published.

sources.coverage: adopted Borough Plan Review 2021-2039, 2025 policies map, property-history personal searches and decision-notice routes
sources.binding_limit: The adopted plan and search routes do not establish the lawful mixed-use configuration, title, building-control completion, rates or residential compliance of 105 Croft Road without a property-specific search and decision-document readback.
